title: Observability & Telemetry
brief: Complete metrics. Session metrics, hook timeline, agent perf, skill analytics, cron reliability, build/test trends, dispatcher profiling, context utilization, error classification, CUSUM/EWMA anomaly detection, weekly reports, retention rollups.

phases.title: Core Metrics Collection
phases.description: Session metrics, hook timeline visualization, and agent performance tracking

units.title: Session Metrics Collector
units.rationale: Track per-session token usage, tool call counts, duration, and outcome for baseline observability
exit_conditions: Session metrics emitted to ~/.prism/telemetry/sessions/
Compact JSON format < 2KB per session

steps.instruction: Create SessionMetricsCollector that hooks session-start and stop events to record token in/out, tool calls by type, wall time, and outcome
Write retention-aware storage (daily rollup, 90-day window)
Add tests for metric accuracy and rollup correctness

units.title: Hook Timeline Visualizer
units.rationale: Visualize hook execution order, latency, and block/warn decisions as a timeline for debugging
exit_conditions: Timeline data structure captures hook chain with timestamps
CLI command renders ASCII timeline

steps.instruction: Instrument pretooluse/posttooluse hooks to emit timestamped trace events
Build timeline renderer (ASCII table with latency bars)
Add tests for timeline ordering and latency calculation

deliverables.description: Hook execution timeline capture and rendering

units.title: Agent Performance Tracker
units.rationale: Track agent tool completion rates, token efficiency, and error rates by model tier
exit_conditions: Per-agent success/fail/timeout rates tracked
Model comparison data available

steps.instruction: Create AgentPerfTracker that intercepts agent tool calls and records outcome, tokens, and latency
Aggregate by model tier (opus/sonnet/haiku) with rolling windows
Add tests for rate calculations and tier bucketing

deliverables.description: Agent performance tracking by model tier

units.title: Skill Analytics Engine
units.rationale: Track skill invocation frequency, success rates, and token cost per skill for optimization
exit_conditions: Per-skill invocation count, success rate, avg tokens tracked
Top-N skills report available

steps.instruction: Hook skill invocations to record name, duration, token cost, and outcome
Build frequency and efficiency rankings with rolling 30-day window
Add tests for ranking correctness and edge cases (zero invocations)

phases.title: System Health Metrics
phases.description: Cron reliability, build/test trends, dispatcher profiling, and context utilization

units.title: Cron Reliability Monitor
units.rationale: Track cron job execution success/failure rates and detect missed schedules
exit_conditions: Cron execution log with success/fail/skip/timeout states
Missed-schedule detection alert

steps.instruction: Create CronReliabilityMonitor that wraps cron execution with outcome tracking
Implement missed-schedule detection using expected vs actual intervals
Add tests for reliability calculation and missed-schedule edge cases

units.title: Build & Test Trend Tracker
units.rationale: Track build times, test pass rates, and bundle size trends over time for regression detection
exit_conditions: Build time, test count, pass rate, bundle size stored per run
Trend direction (improving/degrading) computed

steps.instruction: Hook build and test script outputs to extract duration, pass/fail counts, and bundle size
Store time series and compute 7-day rolling trend direction
Add tests for trend calculation and data extraction parsing

units.title: Dispatcher Profiler
units.rationale: Profile dispatcher action execution times to identify slow actions and import bottlenecks
exit_conditions: Per-action p50/p95/p99 latency tracked
Slow action warnings emitted above threshold

steps.instruction: Wrap dispatcher action execution with high-resolution timing
Compute percentile latencies and flag actions exceeding budget
Add tests for percentile calculation and threshold alerting

units.title: Context Utilization Analyzer
units.rationale: Track how much of the context window is used vs wasted to guide token optimization
exit_conditions: Context utilization ratio (used/available) tracked per turn
Waste categories identified (stale reads, duplicate content)

steps.instruction: Estimate context usage per turn from tool inputs/outputs and system prompts
Classify waste categories (stale file reads, repeated content, oversized outputs)
Add tests for utilization estimation and waste classification

phases.title: Intelligence & Reporting
phases.description: Error classification, anomaly detection, weekly reports, and retention rollups

units.title: Error Classification Engine
units.rationale: Classify errors by type (transient/permanent/config/resource) for targeted remediation
entry_conditions: Session metrics with error data available
exit_conditions: Errors classified into taxonomy with confidence scores
Top error categories surfaced in reports

steps.instruction: Define error taxonomy (transient, permanent, config, resource, timeout, permission)
Build classifier using error message patterns and context
Add tests for classification accuracy across error types

deliverables.description: Error classification by type and severity

units.title: CUSUM/EWMA Anomaly Detection
units.rationale: Detect metric anomalies using CUSUM and EWMA control charts for early warning
exit_conditions: CUSUM and EWMA detectors running on key metrics
Anomaly alerts with severity and affected metric

steps.instruction: Implement CUSUM (cumulative sum) detector with configurable threshold h and slack k
Implement EWMA (exponentially weighted moving average) detector with lambda and L parameters
Wire to key metrics (latency, error rate, token usage) and add tests

deliverables.description: CUSUM/EWMA anomaly detection for system metrics

units.title: Weekly Report Generator
units.rationale: Generate weekly summary reports of system health, usage patterns, and anomalies
entry_conditions: Error classifier and anomaly detection operational
exit_conditions: Weekly report generated as compact JSON + ASCII summary
Report includes top errors, anomalies, trends, and recommendations

steps.instruction: Aggregate weekly data from all metric sources
Generate report with sections: summary, top errors, anomalies, trends, recommendations
Add tests for report generation and edge cases (no data, partial data)

units.title: Retention & Rollup Manager
units.rationale: Manage telemetry data retention with progressive rollups to control disk usage
exit_conditions: Hourly→daily→weekly→monthly rollup pipeline
Disk usage bounded under configurable limit

steps.instruction: Implement tiered rollup: raw (7d) → hourly (30d) → daily (90d) → weekly (1y)
Add disk budget enforcement with oldest-first eviction
Add tests for rollup correctness and budget enforcement

deliverables.description: Telemetry data retention and rollup management
